description: SUBSUMED (2026-08-11) by `chief/70-spec-pin-repin-and-drift-gate`, and PARKED. A verified-defect sweep found the pin lag is not one spec but FOUR — kcb 0.2.0 vs 0.3.0, kinp 0.2.0 vs 0.2.1, kgp 0.4.0 vs 0.5.0, kft 0.3.0 vs 0.4.0 — with `kmi` missing from the table entirely, and no gate anywhere comparing agora's pins to koine (the three language constants are only asserted against EACH OTHER). `chief/70` repins all six in lockstep, records the candidate-version policy, and adds the koine-reading drift gate. Retire this file when `70` merges; run it only if `70` is abandoned. Original scope follows. — Phase F (contract-version pin advances). `SPEC_VERSIONS.kgp` is pinned `0.4.0` in `schemas/src/versions.ts` while koine's KGP is `0.5.0` (Candidate); ingest compares majors only, so a conformant producer that moved first is not rejected. Decide whether to bump the pin 0.4.0 -> 0.5.0 before KGP re-ratifies — and if so, move EVERY language gate in lockstep: `schemas/src/versions.ts` (TS), `agora_provider_router.KCB_VERSION`/the Python constants asserted by `provider-router/tests/` + `trainer/tests/`, and the Erlang constant asserted by `apr_conformance_SUITE`. Bump one without the others and those gates go red (CLAUDE.md 'bump all or those gates go red'). If deferring, record the deferral until KGP re-ratifies. Cross-repo: gated on koine KGP re-ratification. agora gates on `make check`.

userStories.title: Decide: bump now or defer until KGP re-ratifies, and record it
userStories.description: KGP 0.5.0 is Candidate, not ratified; ingest compares majors so 0.4.0 does not reject a 0.5.0 producer. Decide whether to advance the pin before re-ratification or hold at 0.4.0, and record the decision with its rationale (the ongoing 'contract-version tracking' thread).
acceptanceCriteria: A recorded decision (in a doc / ADR-style note / progress.txt) states whether the KGP pin advances to 0.5.0 now or defers until KGP re-ratifies, with the rationale (major-only ingest compare; Candidate vs ratified).
If the decision is to defer, the deferral is documented as the outcome and no version constants change; `make check` green.

`make check` green across every area (TS, Python, Erlang where present); if US-1 deferred, this story is a no-op recorded as such.
